name: Corporate Action Narrative 58
definition: Provides additional information such as the taxation conditions.

Offeror.name: Offeror
Offeror.definition: Provides the entity making the offer and is different from the issuing company.

NewCompanyName.name: New Company Name
NewCompanyName.definition: Provides the new name of a company following a name change.

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Provides the web address published for the event, that is, the address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example, used over the www (HTTP) service.

EventProcessingWebSiteAddress.name: Event Processing Web Site Address
EventProcessingWebSiteAddress.definition: Provides web address of an account servicer (or of a service provider) that contains information solely intended for the immediate account holder to enable or facilitate event processing between parties.

AdditionalInformationRule.definition: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition.
